title: 第1735章 献祭法则搞定暂时解除危机第1734章 血祭本源法则的六大分支
content_zh:
邪神神王虚影六道光轮全部被牵制的这一瞬，李衍道将左掌心的至尊法则融合印记按入了掌印凹槽。
金银紫三色光环在他掌心与凹槽接触的瞬间，骤然膨胀，从三尺扩张到三丈，从三丈扩张到三十丈。
完整的三道至尊法则融合体第一次在封印核心中全面展开，时间法则的推进、空间法则的折叠、轮回法则的循环在三色融合体中同时爆发。
光环中央，那个对应轮回缺口的位置，被李衍道真正的轮回法则完美填补，三色光纹以极快速度在光环中融合成一个整体，然后猛地收缩，精准嵌入封印核心的轮回缺口。
缺口内壁的献祭法则污染，在完整的至尊法则融合体面前如冰雪般消融。
邪神神王虚影在光环嵌入缺口的瞬间，发出了迄今为止最剧烈的一次意志波动。
那波动的强度将正在和魂祭光轮僵持的空冥源帝震飞，将轮回寂源帝的轮回旋涡彻底震碎，将涅盘凤凰的最后几片羽翼震散，小七整个人被震得向后倒飞撞在封印平台边缘的石柱上。
李衍道只觉得一股难以想象的巨力，从凹槽中反震回来，沿着他的左臂传遍全身，六层神国在这一震之下同时剧烈震荡，第四层法则大陆边缘的虚空裂开了数百道裂纹。
但他没有松手。
他借着邪神神王意志反噬的这股力量，将左掌更深入地按入凹槽，三生神血纹在凹槽中，同时爆发出最耀眼的光芒。
金银紫三色神血光纹，沿着封印核心的法则脉络急速扩散，从掌印凹槽扩散到整座封印平台，从封印平台扩散到三条法则锁链，从法则锁链扩散到三座圣殿的时空源核。
整个失落之域的三大断界在这一刻同时安静了下来。
时间断界的时间流速异常被强行统一，空间断界的折叠空间被同时展开，轮回断界的法则层在轮回法则的调和下重新稳定。
邪神神王虚影背后六道光带中的本源祭光轮，在至尊法则融合体嵌入缺口的同时断裂。
六道光带全部断裂，虚影本身也开始从边缘崩塌，暗红色的献祭法则碎片从虚影上剥落，每一片碎片在脱落时，都被缺口周围完整的至尊法则光环净化成虚无。
“你的轮回法则，确实是完整的。”
邪神神王虚影在崩塌中低头看着李衍道，声音已不再有之前的压迫感，反而带上了一丝意外，“太初用了上千万年都没找到的东西，你替他找到了。
但补缺口只是第一步，你只是把封印恢复到了太初当年刚布置完成时的状态。
完整的三大至尊法则封印确实比缺了轮回的封印强，但封印本身是用你的三生神血加固的，不是太初的。
你的修为不如太初，你的三生神血品阶不如太初当年，这道封印能锁住本座多久，你自己心里也没底。”

虚影崩塌到一半时停了一下。
邪神神王用崩塌到只剩头颅和半边躯干的虚影，看了李衍道最后一眼。
“在你真正踏入神王境界之前，这道封印对本座来说不是永久的牢笼，只是需要花更多时间才能重新挣脱的枷锁。
等你踏入了神王境界再来找本座吧。
届时你或许有机会亲眼见证本座真正的全盛姿态。
当然，前提是你没有被他的反噬杀掉。”
虚影在说完这句话后彻底崩塌。
六道光带的碎片和数十丈高的虚影残骸，化作漫天暗红色光点，被缺口周围完整的至尊法则光环，尽数吸入净化。
邪神神王在被重新封印前的最后时刻，用意志留下了一声低沉冷笑，冷笑声在封印平台上，回荡了数息才彻底消散。
一切归于平静。
封印核心的掌印凹槽中，金银紫三色法则光纹重新恢复了正常流转，流转的节奏比加固前稳定了数倍不止。
轮回缺口已被至尊法则融合体完全填补，缺口内壁的献祭法则污染已被彻底净化，缺口边缘的封印纹路在完整的至尊法则加持下，自动修复了之前被震裂的数百处裂纹。
但李衍道的情况并不乐观。
邪神神王意志反噬的那一击，即便被四位源帝和小七的涅盘之火分担了一部分，即便他自己以六层真实神国硬扛，还是给他的神国造成了不小损伤。
第四层法则大陆边缘裂开的数百道虚空裂纹还只是外伤，真正严重的是至尊法则融合体，嵌入缺口时封印核心反震回来的那股力量。
那股力量是太初封印本身对“非太初神王本人”的排斥反应。
封印核心认的是太初的源力，李衍道的源力虽然有三生神血加持，终究不是太初本人的。
排斥反应将他的六层神国同时震出了内伤，第五层至尊法则循环的运转速度降到了不足平时的三成，第六层神国刚刚开辟的虚空边缘也出现了结构松动。
小七从封印平台边缘的石柱旁艰难站起来，涅盘火种已从暗金色凤凰形态缩回了拳头大小，火种表面的光纹暗淡了至少七成。
她将火种重新吞入丹田，走到李衍道身边，用手背擦去李衍道嘴角溢出的血迹。

那是神国内伤在体表的映射。
content_en:
At the moment when all six light wheels of the evil god king's shadow were restrained, Li Yandao pressed the fusion mark of the Supreme Law in his left palm into the palm print groove.
The golden, silver and purple halo suddenly expanded the moment his palm came into contact with the groove, from three feet to three feet, and from three feet to thirty feet.
For the first time, the complete fusion of the three supreme laws unfolded in the core of the seal. The advancement of the law of time, the folding of the law of space, and the cycle of the law of reincarnation broke out simultaneously in the three-color fusion.
In the center of the halo, the position corresponding to the gap in reincarnation was perfectly filled by Li Yandao's true law of reincarnation. The three-color light pattern merged into a whole in the halo at an extremely fast speed, and then shrank suddenly, accurately embedded in the gap in reincarnation at the core of the seal.
The pollution of the Law of Sacrifice on the inner wall of the gap melted like ice and snow in front of the complete fusion of the Supreme Law.
At the moment when the aura embedded in the gap, the shadow of the Evil God King sent out the most violent wave of will so far.
The intensity of the fluctuation knocked away Kongmingyuan Emperor, who was in a stalemate with the Soul Sacrifice Light Wheel, completely shattered the reincarnation vortex of Samsara Jiyuan Emperor, and scattered the last few wings of the Nirvana Phoenix. Xiaoqi was knocked backwards and hit the stone pillar at the edge of the sealing platform.
Li Yandao only felt an unimaginable force coming back from the groove and spreading throughout his body along his left arm. The six-level divine kingdom shook violently at the same time under this shock, and hundreds of cracks opened in the void at the edge of the fourth-level Law Continent.
But he didn't let go.
With the backlash of the Evil God King's will, he pressed his left palm deeper into the groove. The blood lines of the Three Lives Gods were in the groove, and at the same time the most dazzling light erupted.
The golden, silver and purple divine blood light patterns spread rapidly along the law veins at the core of the seal, spreading from the palm print groove to the entire seal platform, from the seal platform to the three law chains, and from the law chains to the space-time source core of the three temples.
The three major realms of the entire Lost Realm fell silent at the same time.
The anomalies in the time flow rate of the time gap are forcibly unified, the folded space of the space gap is simultaneously unfolded, and the law layer of the reincarnation gap is re-stabilized under the mediation of the law of reincarnation.
The origin sacrificial light wheel in the six light belts behind the shadow of the evil god and king broke when the fusion body of the Supreme Law was inserted into the gap.
All six light bands broke, and the shadow itself began to collapse from the edge. Dark red fragments of the Law of Sacrifice peeled off from the shadow. When each fragment fell off, it was purified into nothingness by the complete aura of the Supreme Law around the gap.
"Your law of reincarnation is indeed complete."
The phantom of the Evil God King looked down at Li Yandao during the collapse, his voice no longer had the sense of oppression before, but instead contained a hint of surprise, "You found something for him that Taichu had spent tens of millions of years not finding.
But filling the gap is only the first step. You are just restoring the seal to the state it was in when it was first laid out in the beginning.
The complete seal of the three supreme laws is indeed stronger than the seal without reincarnation, but the seal itself is reinforced with your three lives of divine blood, not from the beginning.
Your cultivation level is not as good as Taichu's, and your three-life divine blood level is not as good as Taichu's. You don't know how long this seal can lock me. "
The phantom paused halfway through its collapse.
The Evil God King gave Li Yandao one last look with his phantom that collapsed until only his head and half of his torso were left.
"Before you truly step into the realm of the God King, this seal is not a permanent prison for me, it is just a shackle that takes more time to break free from.
Come to me again when you have entered the realm of the God King.
By then you may have the opportunity to witness with your own eyes the true glory of this throne.
Of course, the premise is that you are not killed by his backlash. "
The shadow completely collapsed after saying this.
The fragments of the six light belts and the phantom remains dozens of feet high turned into dark red light spots all over the sky, surrounded by the complete Supreme Law around the gap.Halo, inhale all the purification.
In the last moment before being re-sealed, the Evil God King used his will to leave a deep sneer. The sneer echoed on the sealing platform for several breaths before it completely dissipated.
Everything is calm.
In the palm print groove at the core of the seal, the gold, silver, and purple light patterns returned to normal circulation, and the rhythm of circulation was several times more stable than before reinforcement.
The reincarnation gap has been completely filled by the fusion of the Supreme Law. The pollution of the Sacrifice Law on the inner wall of the gap has been completely purified. The sealing lines on the edge of the gap have automatically repaired hundreds of cracks that were previously shattered by the blessing of the complete Supreme Law.
But Li Yandao's situation is not optimistic.
The backlash of the Evil God King's will, even if part of it was shared by the Nirvana Fire of the four Origin Emperors and Xiao Qi, and even if he was able to withstand it with his own six-level real Divine Kingdom, it still caused considerable damage to his Divine Kingdom.
The hundreds of void cracks that opened on the edge of the fourth-level Law Continent were just external injuries. What was really serious was the power of the Supreme Law Fusion body that rebounded from the seal core when it was embedded in the gap.
That power is the Taichu Seal's own rejection of "those who are not the Taichu God King himself".
The core of the seal recognizes Taichu's source power. Although Li Yandao's source power is blessed by the blood of the three lives, it is not Taichu himself after all.
The rejection reaction caused internal injuries in his sixth-level divine kingdom at the same time. The speed of the fifth-level supreme law cycle dropped to less than 30% of the usual speed. The edge of the void that the sixth-level divine kingdom had just opened also had structural looseness.
Xiao Qi stood up with difficulty from the stone pillar at the edge of the sealing platform. The Nirvana Fire had shrunk from the dark golden phoenix form to the size of a fist, and the light patterns on the surface of the Fire had dimmed by at least 70%.
She swallowed the fire into her Dantian again, walked to Li Yandao, and wiped away the blood that spilled from the corner of Li Yandao's mouth with the back of her hand.
That is the reflection of God's internal injuries on his body surface.
